contentBody: **Which control runs the whole workflow one time for testing purposes?**
option.2: The Publish button in the top bar

contentBody: **What starts a workflow running by itself?**
option.1: An action node that sends data to an app
option.4: A trigger node waiting for events
answerExplanation: A trigger waits for an event and starts the run; actions follow it.

contentBody: **A node's parameter reads {{ $json.Email }}. What kind of value is it exactly?**

contentBody: **A form trigger outputs three items. How many rows does the Append Row node add?**
answerExplanation: Most nodes run once per incoming item.
